payload.classificationReason: Exact identities/FT metadata/actual observation times/raw hashes recoverable for 12 current fixtures. Only 3 sampled fixtures per league, below per-team minimum 5 even in best case; 110 stored-inventory FT fixtures have no local feature observation. Historical adapter is not prospective-safe. Partial data foundation exists; operational launch is not ready.

classificationContract.referenceTime: For statusAtAudit, auditObservedAt is an audit reference only, not a prediction timestamp.
classificationContract.OBSERVED_BEFORE_TARGET: Latest identifiable receipt <= locked prediction cutoff; complete valid feature on both teams. Cutoff <= predictionCreatedAt.
classificationContract.OBSERVED_AFTER_TARGET: Receipts exist but all postdate the comparison cutoff. Availability at the earlier cutoff is not inferred.
classificationContract.MISSING: No local observation (NOT_COLLECTED, not provider absence), or latest eligible response has absent/null feature; reason retained.
classificationContract.UNKNOWN: Missing/unverifiable timestamp, conflicting receipt, identity or provenance; never eligible.
classificationContract.missingAfter: A post-cutoff missing response does not prove the feature was missing before cutoff; receipt timing and field presence are separate.
classificationContract.counting: 14 receipt observations represent 12 unique fixtures. Same-hash rechecks retain actual times but do not increase training sample count.

observation.fixtureBinding: Exact requested fixture ID + both team IDs + separately hash-bound schedule/FT metadata; no fuzzy identity.
observation.retention: Append-only; each retrieval gets its own timestamp and observation ID, even when raw bytes repeat. Content-address raw bytes; never count rechecks as another fixture.
observation.revisions: New observation event only; previous events and prior prediction inputs immutable. No backdated observedAt.
observation.missing: ABSENT/NULL/NOT_COLLECTED/INVALID distinguished; no imputation, zero-fill, proxy feature or cross-provider replacement.
observation.enforcement: Hash verification and exclusive write required; current evidence is hash-verifiable, not a WORM storage guarantee.

temporal.cutoffAt: Actual input-lock time <= predictionCreatedAt, fixed before computation.
temporal.eligible: same league, Regular Season FT, different fixture, prior kickoff < cutoffAt and < target kickoff, kickoff >= cutoffAt - 365 days, actual FT and feature observations <= cutoffAt <= predictionCreatedAt.
temporal.observationSelection: Latest complete response receipt at/before cutoff for each fixture; inspect its individual feature availability. Do not fall back to an older non-null value when a later eligible response is missing. Conflicting same-time receipts or unverifiable timestamps => UNKNOWN/exclude.
temporal.inputLock: Select and seal exact values/receipt hashes before calculation. Observations arriving during calculation or later are excluded. Same-kickoff group uses a fixed evidence view; no own/same-group result input.
temporal.deadline: Only future NS targets; calculation and seal at least 60 seconds before kickoff. No backfill after kickoff.

featureGate.perFeaturePools: Frozen masks; a missing prior-match feature excludes that row from that feature pool only. Full target denominator retained.
featureGate.unknown: Unknown identity/hash/temporal provenance cannot become a valid observation; integrity corruption blocks run, not an invented value.
featureGate.singleMissing: One missing xG row is not automatically a target-wide PASS if all frozen sufficiency gates are still met; otherwise preserve PASS.
featureGate.otherFrozenRules: Keep existing nonpositive-feature-mean, base-history, numerical and rate gates; no threshold relaxation.

frozen.h2: Frozen causal H2 estimator is the unpromoted offset backbone. Any future per-target H2 causal calculation uses only actual observed eligible FT history; this is not permission to refit R1 map/beta. No H2 execution in this mission.
frozen.adapterRequired: Historical source rejects season 2026 and applies synthetic +48h. A separately authorized observation adapter with matched-input mathematical equivalence and temporal firewall tests is required; do not call the historical runner directly.

snapshot.officialReference: Separate read-only officialForwardPrediction {fixtureId,snapshotHash,predictionCreatedAt}; optional reference absence is reported, never generated by shadow.
snapshot.shadowReference: r1ShadowPrediction has independent envelope and storage.
snapshot.revisions: V1 protocol uses one initial snapshot per target, no routine prediction revision. Future revision policy requires separate authorization; never after kickoff.

coverage.miss: Only previously observed pregame target without a valid shadow seal after kickoff is MISSED_PREGAME_SNAPSHOT. Never turn unseen provider-outage fixtures into invented MISS. Do not backfill.

grading.source: Official API FT regular-time result, observed after match completion and after pregame seal.
grading.corrections: Append-only grade revision with previous hash/reason; immutable checkpoint remains as originally sealed.

milestones.unit: Valid graded R1 PREDICTED targets across the four leagues, deduplicated by fixture ID; PASS excluded from milestone N but fully reported.
milestones.order: gradedAt then numeric fixtureId; seal exact first N IDs and hash once per milestone. Crossing multiple checkpoints in one batch seals each exact prefix.
milestones.comparison: Report R1 full graded-PREDICTED N, then paired R1 vs already-sealed official v1 on the exact shared target IDs. Official PASS/absence and paired count reported; never substitute a later official prediction or alter milestone N.
milestones.metricDefinition: Frozen V3 metrics implementation; report per-league and pooled prospective-only denominators, null where undefined. No historical/forward accuracy pooling.
milestones.review: Only 25/50/100/200 formal checkpoints. Intermediate data operational only; no adaptive tuning. N<100 cannot justify engine/Forward/recommendation changes. N>=100 requires separate protocol/CTO review; no automatic promotion at any N.

launchPrerequisites: Separately authorized current feature observation collector and append-only store; retain failures/missingness without sample substitution.

Establish actual observed 365-day feature and FT history coverage. Existing 2026 samples alone are insufficient; this audit does not read or repurpose 2025 holdout raw evidence. Any previous-season warm-up needs a separate provenance/scope decision, never confirmatory holdout reuse.
Implement and test a separate observed-time R1 adapter without modifying frozen numerical formulas or final parameters.
Test pregame immutability, temporal/identity firewalls, missingness PASS, separate grading, paired denominator and checkpoint behavior.
Separate CTO authorization before first shadow run/watch; official Forward and recommendations remain untouched.

searchScope.method: Known committed access/census manifests and current/statistics/probe filename discovery; unrelated formats and external stores not certified.
searchScope.excludedRaw: 2025 holdout raw and all historical execution raw prediction/feature stores were not opened; final 2023 parameter seals and committed result summaries only.
